offline-frontend-tests:
    name: Offline frontend tests (${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_TEST_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
      - name: Verify source and capture the original Host test runtime
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD"
          echo "AGENT_BACKEND_TEST_NODE=$(node -p 'process.execPath')" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Setup the original workspace test runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Prepare original test prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y lsof
          node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs --child-concurrency=1
          node scripts/ci/rebuild-better-sqlite3-node.cjs
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build
          pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Run the complete safe frontend shard
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Live subscriptions and real vendor executables are outside this finite lane.
          # Excluded files remain unqualified; the existing native gates are unchanged.
          pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --shard="$HOST_TEST_SHARD/4" \
            --exclude '**/*.live.test.*' --exclude '**/*.live-e2e.test.*' --exclude '**/*.native.test.*' \
            --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-offline-tests-$HOST_TEST_SHARD.json" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-offline-tests-$HOST_TEST_SHARD.log"
      - name: Preserve original test results, including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: host-offline-tests-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ matrix.shard }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/host-offline-tests-*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/host-offline-tests-*.log
